name: Yuri
source:
Yuri is a young woman who recently started working with [url=/c68617]Chika[/url] at Moon River Café, which [url=/c68619]Keisuke[/url] frequents quite often. She is very seriously involved in her work and this can be explained because she absolutely wants to make her biggest dream come true. 

Yuri has a serious aura and she doesn't hesitate to put her best friend back in place when she thinks she doesn't express herself politely enough to customers.

[spoiler]She is from Kosovo, her mother of Japanese origin fled with her in the late 1990s while her father stayed to fight.[/spoiler]
